findings.source: Gsm4626: PRICE_STRATEGY / UNDERLYING_ASSET / GHO_TOKEN are immutables
findings.issue: The price strategy, underlying vault and GHO token are solc immutables, zero in the pre-deployment runtime code, so their calls read as calls to 0x0.

notes: No source loops and no whiles. The four 150-300 line functions (buyAsset, sellAsset and their WithSig variants, distributeFeesToTreasury-like c350de6c/aa443ac0) read in full for calls, storage writes, events and reverts; the rest fully. The text follows the source: frozen/seized checks, fee strategy calls guarded by `if stor57`, checked additions/subtractions (some reassociated, e.g. `_5 - _13 + _2 > _5 + _2`), exposure/accrued-fee updates, GHO mint/burn and asset transfers. Parameter names of database-known selectors come from other contracts (`buyAsset(uint256 _ths, address _referral)`, `getBuyFee(uint256 _tokenId)`), harmless. P2: calls to the price strategy and vault with raw-memory arguments; P8: selector stores before named calls. No semantic error found.
summary: Clean, faithful text without loops; the only visible oddities are immutable call targets printed as 0x0 (pre-deployment artifact) and some raw-memory call arguments.
